description:
Reply to a ticket

Adds a public reply to an existing ticket and bumps its last-changed timestamp, which is what moves the ticket back up the support queue. A ticket in state `closed` cannot be replied to and returns 400; a resolved ticket still accepts replies, so use this to reopen a conversation that was closed too early. Attachments are referenced by URL, they are not uploaded here: host the file somewhere the support team can reach and pass the link. The reply emits the `ticket.updated` outbound webhook event.

body.description: The reply text and, optionally, a list of attachments. Each attachment describes an already-hosted file: its name, a URL the support team can download it from, its content type and its size in bytes.

attachments.description: Optional list of file attachments supporting the message.

filename.description: The name of the uploaded file.

mimeType.description: The logical file type (e.g., image/png, application/pdf).

url.description: The public URL where the attachment is hosted.

message.description: The content of your reply or update.

ticketId.description: Ticket identifier, with or without the `ticket_` prefix.

name: reply_to_ticket
title: Reply to a ticket
